prompts.officeMasterPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: master center keyframe for an interactive personal website office scene.
Create a beautiful polished Pixar-style 3D animated-film render of the user's actual home office, using the supplied photos for the exact furniture and room and the portrait for the man's likeness. Image 1 is office layout reference. Image 2 is monitor and stand reference. Image 3 is lamp reference. Image 4 is portrait likeness reference. Image 5 is the existing website's 3D cartoon style reference, NOT its furniture/layout or beard.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas, straight-on camera from the visitor side of the desk facing the man and back wall, no isometric view. A compact room vignette with full desk legs and cream shag rug visible, softly rounded room boundary surrounded by plain warm off-white. Central oak desktop on two white electric sit-stand legs. Centered white curved ultrawide monitor: we see its BACK and silver stand, not its screen. A small white webcam on its top edge. The monitor obscures the seated man's torso and lower face; his eyes, brows, forehead and hair are visible above the top, looking down toward his work, concentrated and pleasantly amused. He sits in his grey mesh ergonomic chair, in a plain light grey sweatshirt, dark jeans, white sneakers, hands naturally typing behind the monitor. Slim man early 30s, fair skin, short side-swept dark blond hair, blue eyes, long face, prominent friendly nose, light blond mustache and sparse short stubble matching portrait. No full thick beard, no glasses, no hat.
Room geometry from references: broad panel of vertical natural oak acoustic slats on black felt directly behind desk, flanked by dusty clay-pink wall. Window and dark taupe curtain at far left. To the right, fully visible low oak cabinet with white chevron-grooved double doors and short tapered wooden legs. On cabinet the exact cream ceramic inverted-U arch lamp with tall cylindrical oatmeal linen shade; green silver-variegated leafy houseplant beside it. Lamp must be unobscured and clearly readable as clickable target. White fluffy rectangular rug underneath desk/chair, warm oak floor. Simplify clutter: one cream coffee mug and small silver desktop computer, no loose cables, no extra screens.
Lighting: soft daylight from left, lamp OFF, warm natural oak and pink palette, soft contact shadows, tactile fabric and wood, stylized rounded forms, charming cinematic character sculpt matching website style.
Constraints: one person, one monitor, one lamp. Entire furniture grouping within frame with breathing space, no text, no watermark, no UI, no extra decor. This is the master scene to preserve in later camera and lighting variants.
